basis: The October 30 results release qualifies. Douglas Dynamics reported consolidated GAAP net sales of $144,121,000 for the three months ended September 30, 2023, down 13.23% from $166,100,000 a year earlier and below the $157,795,000 cutoff. The earliest qualifying date remains unverified because the full contents of earlier investor presentations could not be confirmed. The upper_bound below is the verified actual.

coverage.detail: April 17 preliminary results covered Q1. Management lowered its full-year outlook and anticipated weaker preseason orders without quantifying consolidated Q3 sales.

The May 1 Q1 release gave a $620 million to $650 million full-year net-sales range. The warning about lower preseason orders concerned Work Truck Attachments. Neither figure established a consolidated Q3 ceiling.
On the May 2 call, management discussed the snowfall-driven reduction in annual guidance and its effect on Attachments volumes. The remarks located supplied no consolidated Q3 sales ceiling.

On July 31 the company reiterated $620 million to $650 million for 2023. The approximate 60/40 Q2/Q3 split applied to Attachments preseason revenue. It provided neither a firm high end nor a Q3 sales figure for Work Truck Solutions.

During August 1 call Q&A, management discussed how dealer inventory could shift the preseason mix. The more extreme splits were posed by an analyst. Management did not establish a consolidated Q3 sales ceiling in that exchange.
This external inventory lists investor presentations dated May 16 and August 10, 2023. I could not verify complete issuer copies of either deck. The inventory establishes a gap in coverage.

The September 20 Form 8-K identifies a presentation dated September 18 for the September 20–22 D.A. Davidson conference. I verified the filing and exhibit identification. The image-based slides and any accompanying public management remarks could not be fully read and checked for a Q3 forecast.
The issuer’s intervening press releases were the September 6 dividend declaration and October 17 earnings-call notice. The archive timestamps the Q3 results release October 30 at 6:00 p.m. EDT.
The October 30 release gives both periods on the same consolidated income statement. The three-month net-sales row, in thousands, is 144,121 for 2023 and 166,100 for 2022.

publication_date_evidence: The issuer’s press-release archive records October 30, 2023 at 6:00 p.m. EDT, and the release furnished as SEC Exhibit 99.1 carries the October 30 dateline. This verifies public availability of the actuals before the October 31 filings. The earlier presentation gaps prevent assigning October 30 as the onset date.
